item.description:
Anthropic Raises $5B Series D at $60B Valuation

item.title: China Issues New AI Safety Regulation Draft
item.description:
China Issues New AI Safety Regulation Draft

China released a draft regulation mandating safety assessments for all large language models deployed domestically, covering content safety, data privacy, and algorithmic transparency. Industry experts warn this could slow deployment timelines. Public comment is open until June 2026.

来源

item.description:
OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Real-Time Reasoning

OpenAI announced the release of GPT-5, featuring real-time reasoning, improved multimodal understanding, and state-of-the-art coding performance. The model can process video, audio, and text simultaneously, and will be available via API starting next week.

item.title: 上海大航跃迁完成5亿元融资，推进国内首款塔架回收火箭研制
item.description:
上海大航跃迁完成5亿元融资，推进国内首款塔架回收火箭研制

上海大航跃迁航天科技有限公司完成5亿元融资，用于研制国内首款采用“筷子夹”塔架回收技术的运载火箭“跃迁一号”，计划2027年首飞。公司是国内首家落地该技术的二代民营火箭企业，本轮融资由多家机构领投，资金将用于火箭研制及液氧甲烷发动机研发。
